title: Generative Adversarial Networks
description: Minimax theory, mode collapse, DCGAN, conditional GAN, WGAN-GP, StyleGAN concepts, and evaluation metrics (IS/FID).
objectives: Implement GAN, DCGAN, and conditional GAN
Evaluate generative models with IS and FID
keyTakeaways: GAN minimax: generator minimizes log(1-D(G(z))), discriminator maximizes log(D(x)) + log(1-D(G(z))) — adversarial equilibrium
Mode collapse = generator produces only a few plausible outputs, ignoring most of the real data distribution
WGAN-GP replaces JS divergence with Wasserstein distance + gradient penalty — more stable training and meaningful loss curve
FID (Frechet Inception Distance) compares feature statistics of real vs generated images; lower = more realistic and diverse
Conditional GANs inject class labels into both G and D, enabling targeted generation (e.g. generate a cat, not a random image)
